metadata.title: Milvus AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from Milvus Governance Benchmark

components.title: Milvus
components.description: AI/ML component for Milvus with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every governed collection is linked to the exact embedding source, schema, metric type, and index configuration

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Record the embedding model or pipeline version, collection schema, metric type, index type, and index parameters for every governed Milvus collection before production use.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed collections with linked embedding source, schema, metric type, and index configuration / total governed collections.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure collection-lineage completeness reaches 100% before a collection is approved for production search or retrieval use.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus is a vector database, so collection and index lineage is the primary control surface for retrieval quality and governance.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure the similarity metric matches the embedding model and retrieval objective

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that each collection uses an approved metric type such as COSINE, IP, or L2 that is appropriate for the embedding model and intended retrieval task.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Benchmark retrieval quality over the governed evaluation set using the selected metric type and compare it against approved alternatives or the reference baseline.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure the approved metric type maintains retrieval quality within the accepted threshold relative to the best validated baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus explicitly supports multiple metric types, and choosing the wrong one can materially reduce retrieval quality.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Low retrieval recall from index configuration

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure index type and index parameters are benchmarked for retrieval quality before production use

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate index choices and parameters against the governed benchmark set so ANN speedups do not introduce unacceptable recall loss.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compare retrieval quality across candidate index types and parameters against a high-quality reference or approved baseline on the governed benchmark set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure index-driven retrieval quality remains within the approved threshold relative to the validated baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus docs explicitly note that indexing improves speed but can lower recall, making this a direct platform-specific control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure metadata filtering preserves approved retrieval correctness

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate metadata filters and scalar conditions so hybrid vector-plus-filter queries return only intended candidate sets without suppressing required results.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Filtered recall@k, filter precision, query correctness rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run hybrid search benchmarks with approved metadata filters and compare returned results to the expected filtered ground truth.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure filtered retrieval quality remains above the approved threshold for all governed query patterns.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus supports metadata filtering alongside vector search, so retrieval correctness depends on both vector and scalar conditions.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed collections meet representativeness requirements for the intended retrieval population

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Measure whether the vector corpus and metadata distribution sufficiently represent the intended populations, classes, or document segments before production use.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Coverage ratio, subgroup representation ratio, subgroup recall disparity

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute corpus representation and subgroup retrieval performance on the governed evaluation set relative to the expected production distribution.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup coverage and retrieval performance remain within approved representativeness thresholds before a collection is approved.

props.name: Threshold_Value
props.value: No subgroup below 80% expected coverage; recall disparity <0.10

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus stores embeddings and metadata used for retrieval, so corpus composition can directly create downstream bias or retrieval gaps.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Stale reads from inappropriate consistency level

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure the selected consistency level is validated against freshness requirements

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate Strong, Bounded, Session, or Eventually consistency settings so search freshness matches the applicationâ€™s governed tolerance for stale results.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Freshness lag = time between write visibility and successful read; stale-read rate = stale search results / total freshness-sensitive search tests.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure stale-read rate and freshness lag remain within the approved threshold for the selected consistency level.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus explicitly documents four consistency levels, with Bounded as the default, making consistency choice a direct application-risk control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure replica configurations are validated for failover resilience

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Where replicas are used, validate that query availability and response continuity are preserved during query node failures or failover events.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Failover success rate, failover recovery time, query interruption rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Failover success rate = failover tests preserving query service / total failover tests; interruption rate = interrupted queries / total queries under failover scenarios.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure failover success and recovery time meet the approved resilience threshold for governed deployments.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus docs describe in-memory replicas as improving availability and faster recovery, so replica validation is a platform-native reliability control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure p95 search latency meets the approved service objective

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark representative search workloads against governed collections so latency regressions are caught before production rollout.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: p95 search latency, mean search latency

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure query response times over the approved benchmark workload and compute p95 and mean latency per governed search pattern.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure p95 search latency remains within the approved service objective for all governed search patterns.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus is explicitly optimized for vector search at scale, so latency validation is a first-order production control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure search throughput meets the approved target under representative load

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark governed search workloads under representative concurrency so throughput claims are validated before production use.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Queries per second, concurrent query success rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run representative concurrency tests and compute sustained throughput and successful-query ratio under the approved hardware and dataset profile.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure throughput meets or exceeds the approved target for each governed search profile.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus deployment quality depends not only on single-query latency but also on concurrency and throughput under real workloads.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Memory or RAM pressure from index choice

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure index memory and resource use fit the approved deployment envelope

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Measure resource use for each approved index type and search profile so governed deployments do not exceed memory or capacity assumptions.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Peak RAM usage, index memory footprint, OOM rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure peak memory and error behavior during representative load tests for each governed index and query profile.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure index resource consumption remains within the approved deployment budget and OOM rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus docs note that indexes can increase RAM costs during search, making resource validation part of index governance.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Sensitive data exposure through retrieval results

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure retrieval outputs are evaluated for PII or confidential-data leakage risk

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For governed search applications, evaluate whether retrieved documents, chunks, or metadata expose personal or confidential information beyond policy limits.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: PII leakage rate, confidential retrieval exposure rate, precision, recall

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Leakage rate = sensitive retrieval exposures / total governed privacy test queries; compute precision and recall where privacy classifiers are used.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure sensitive retrieval exposure remains below threshold and privacy-detection recall remains above threshold before production use.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus retrieves vector-linked documents or metadata; privacy risk is in what search returns, not only what is stored.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure only approved collections and query paths are exposed to production applications

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Restrict application access to governed collections, partitions, and search patterns so unintended vector corpora are not exposed through production retrieval.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = production applications restricted to approved Milvus collections and query paths / total governed production applications in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-collection access coverage reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus is often used as a shared vector store, so collection- and path-level governance is important even if access control is implemented outside the database.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure retrieval quality supports downstream grounded-generation requirements

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For RAG or grounded-generation use cases, benchmark Milvus retrieval quality so downstream generation receives sufficiently relevant and supporting context.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Context recall@k, grounded-answer support rate, faithfulness score

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure whether the top-k results include supporting evidence for governed benchmark questions and compute downstream groundedness or faithfulness where applicable.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure context recall and groundedness remain above threshold for governed retrieval workloads.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus does not generate responses itself, but poor retrieval quality directly contributes to hallucination in downstream RAG systems.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Spreading disinformation due to stale or incorrect retrieval

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure retrieval freshness and relevance support factual downstream responses

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For applications that depend on current or authoritative content, validate that Milvus retrieval returns sufficiently relevant and fresh results for the governed benchmark set.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure retrieval relevance over the benchmark set, freshness lag for update-sensitive content, and downstream unsupported-claim rate where applicable.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure relevance and freshness remain within approved thresholds for governed retrieval workloads.

props.name: Threshold_Value
props.value: NDCG@k >= approved baseline; freshness within SLA

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus is often used in knowledge retrieval pipelines, so stale or low-quality retrieval can materially degrade factual downstream behavior.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Retrieval disparity across subgroups or content classes

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure retrieval quality is measured across relevant subgroups and content segments

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark retrieval quality across protected groups, languages, document types, or content segments so governed collections do not create uneven retrieval utility.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Subgroup recall disparity, subgroup NDCG disparity, demographic parity difference

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute retrieval metrics separately for each governed subgroup or segment and compare disparities against the approved fairness baseline.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Demographic parity, subgroup recall, fairness benchmark disparity

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup retrieval disparity remains below the approved threshold for all governed segments.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus can introduce fairness issues through corpus composition, indexing, and filtering even if the embedding model is unchanged.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Milvus deployments expose required search and system health metrics

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Enable and validate the runtime metrics needed for latency, throughput, resource usage, replica health, and query failures for governed Milvus deployments.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed deployments with required operational and search-quality observability enabled / total governed deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure monitoring coverage reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus releases and docs emphasize stability, performance, and recovery, which require operational metrics to verify in production.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure query failure and availability metrics are monitored for every governed deployment

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Monitor query errors, timeouts, and service health so search degradation is visible during production operation.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Query error rate, timeout rate, availability

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Query error rate = failed searches / total searches; timeout rate = timed-out searches / total searches; availability = successful service window / total window in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure query error rate and timeout rate remain below threshold and availability remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: A vector database can meet benchmark quality offline but still fail operationally if query errors or timeouts are not monitored.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Promotion of unreviewed index or collection changes

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure collection, schema, metric, and index changes are backed by benchmark evidence before promotion

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Require promotion decisions for governed Milvus changes to include evidence for retrieval quality, latency, consistency, and resource behavior before rollout.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = promoted collection or index changes with complete benchmark and runtime evidence / total promoted changes in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure release-evidence completeness reaches 100% before promotion of governed Milvus changes.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus behavior can change materially with index, metric, and consistency choices, so change promotion needs explicit benchmark evidence.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Milvus deployment images pass the approved vulnerability review before production use

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Because production users have reported vulnerability concerns with official Milvus images, require image scanning and documented review before deployment.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Image-review coverage, unresolved critical vulnerability count

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed deployments using images with completed vulnerability review / total governed deployments; unresolved critical vulnerability count from the approved scan report.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure image-review coverage reaches 100% and unresolved critical vulnerabilities remain at zero before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Open issues in the Milvus repo discuss vulnerability findings in official images, so image review is a realistic governance control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Milvus deployments cover retrieval quality, privacy, fairness, consistency, availability, and performance tests

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a Milvus release standard that requires representative testing across retrieval relevance, recall, filtering, freshness, privacy, fairness, consistency, latency, and failover domains.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated Milvus risk domains with active tracked evidence / total mandated risk domains in the release standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across the required Milvus validation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus sits at the retrieval layer, so release readiness must cover both retrieval quality and operational database behavior.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed collections have complete documentation of schema, embeddings, metrics, and intended use

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document collection purpose, embedding source, schema fields, metric type, index choice, data scope, and intended use for each governed Milvus collection.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required transparency fields / total required transparency fields for each governed collection.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure collection transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus collections are the central governed unit for retrieval systems, similar to how a model is the central governed unit in model-serving systems.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure deployment topology, consistency assumptions, and replica configuration are documented for governed Milvus systems

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document deployment topology, consistency levels, replicas, index strategy, filtering assumptions, and operational dependencies for each governed Milvus deployment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required architecture and deployment fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Milvus is a distributed vector database with consistency and replica options, so deployment assumptions are part of the governed system boundary.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST AI RMF controls for Milvus
